comment: HostSIL fault injection: encoder stream stall under the legacy FOC control path (foc start). The encoder_freeze stops all encoder DMA samples at 2.2 s; the firmware's sample-age watchdog (ENCODER_STALE_MS = 5 ms in FocControlManager::onPwmPeriod) trips EncoderTimeout/EncoderSampleTimeout and requests a safe stop. Same motor and config seeds as sil_foc_demo; graph control is not auto-started (control.start=false) because the ENCODER_STALE_MS check lives in the legacy FOC manager. The run gates: foc start at 1.6 s via the commands block, stall at 2.2 s, fault latched, control does not resume by itself.
